findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因子：若公司跟不上技術發展，營運或競爭地位可能受損；使用 AI 等新興技術帶來業務、合規與聲譽風險。未點名具體取代性技術。
findings.excerpt: If we are unable to keep pace with developments, design, and implementation in technology, our operations or competitive position could become impaired. Our use of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, may present business, compliance and reputational risks.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出具備建造/維修能力的船廠數量有限，供應鏈中斷因替代選項少而衝擊業務（替代供應商面向，非替代產品）。
findings.excerpt: There are a limited number of shipyards with the capability and capacity to build, repair, maintain and/or upgrade our ships. As such, any disruptions affecting the shipyard supply chain will adversely impact our business as there are limited substitutes.

findings.claim: RCL Q3 2026 財報電話會：公司擁有大量土地、逾100個目的地專案，並規劃約30億美元取得 Sandals and Beaches Resorts 50% 股權（陸上度假替代品的因應）。
findings.source: Cruise Industry News: Royal Caribbean hints at untapped global land holdings
findings.excerpt: “By the way, we also sit on a lot of land around the world, which we don’t talk a lot about,” he said. Liberty did not elaborate on where the holdings are located or how much land is involved. The comment came as he discussed the company’s planned $3 billion investment for a 50 percent stake in Sandals and Beaches Resorts.

findings.claim: 產業觀點：郵輪業調整產品以對抗陸上度假村與主題樂園，預期2026成長放緩。
findings.source: Maritime Executive: global cruise outlook new challenges
findings.excerpt: The industry has adjusted its product to compete with land-based resorts and theme parks, adding more short cruises in the broad, mass-market segment known as contemporary cruising as well as in the premium segment.

substitute_technology.note: 未找到正在崛起、取代郵輪核心產品的替代『技術』；主要替代品為陸上度假（飯店、度假村、主題樂園），搜尋摘要顯示 RCL 以自有目的地/收購 Sandals 股權回應（Q3 2026 財報電話會），但未取得可逐字複製原文，以 clues 保留。 線索 2 條，程式核實 2 條
